response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth across multiple languages and domains, with clear experience in developer tooling, test automation, and CI/CD infrastructure, but lacks explicit evidence of people management, team leadership, or organizational change initiatives required for this engineering productivity manager role.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience building developer tools (test runners, code generators, CI systems)
Proven track record in test automation, TDD, and engineering best practices across teams
Active open-source contributions and knowledge sharing through workshops and talks
concerns: No clear evidence of formal people management or team leadership experience beyond technical roles
Lacks demonstrated experience in roadmap planning or leading organizational change in engineering productivity
Mobile platform expertise is implied but not explicitly validated in recent roles
